question: Emma Raducanu is a professional tennis player from ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The UK.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Emma Raducanu** is a professional tennis player from The UK. 
 
• US Open champion Emma Raducanu has been voted BBC Sports Personality of the Year 2021.
 
• She has become the third WTA (Women's Tennis Association) player to win the award in its 67-year history.
 
• Raducanu became the first British woman to win a Grand Slam singles title after defeating Leylah Fernandez.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Grand Slam itinerary consists of:
 
 
• the Australian Open in mid-January,
 
• the French Open (also known as Roland Garros) from around late May to early June,
 
• Wimbledon in June–July, and
 
• the US Open in August–September.
 
 
 
• Each tournament is played over a two-week period.
 
• Rafael Nadal is the winner of most Grand Slams titles with 22 titles to his name.
